limitations: Path/inode validation assumes exclusive control of output directories; hostile concurrent directory mutation is outside this batch boundary.
Older runs cannot reconstruct original configuration paths that were never captured. Known local sources, SmartID references and current dotenv inputs remain protected.
Benchmarks use small synthetic finite-source workloads, three repetitions and a shared host. They do not establish p95/p99 latency, heavy-workload limits or operational availability.
Reference implementations and default Python installation remain usable without a compiler. Explicit native selection still requires a valid compiled build.
